title: Dynamics of the spontaneous emission factor in multiple quantum well nanowire lasers
summary: The spontaneous emission factor - often known as the \b{eta} factor - is an important quantity in the description of quantum well lasers, influencing both the threshold power as well as the general shape of the light in-light out (L-L) curve. Past work on modelling multiple quantum well (MQW) nanowire laser devices has typically assumed that the \b{eta} factor is a constant parameter that can either be estimated or fit in a post-hoc manner.
